Decision: No city landing pages by default
Recommendation: The business has no verified storefront/service location, local stock, delivery details, staff, or distinct city content. Nationwide delivery alone is not enough to justify near-duplicate city pages. Use a national Pakistan-serving experience and clearly documented delivery coverage.

Unique_Content_Requirement: Store-specific opening hours, staffed customer access, photos, directions, actual inventory/service, accessibility and parking where verified.
Recommendation: Publish only for a real eligible customer-facing location; make each page useful and distinct.

Unique_Content_Requirement: Describe the actual in-person service, coverage, scheduling, and limitations with evidence.
Recommendation: Only if TechFind staff visit customers in person for eligible services; ordinary shipping does not support fake local claims.
